protocol: 25892 development rows and 4317 confirmation rows held out first. Grouped 5-fold cross-validation with 3 seeds (each seed its own fold assignment). Stage 1: successive halving of 34 configurations on 2 folds with budgets [8, 16, 32] epochs. Stage 2: 10 configurations x 15 runs, AdamW, warm-up 1 epoch, cosine decay to 0.1 of the rate, EMA 0.999, early stopping on validation cross-entropy (patience 10, at most 100 epochs). Targets: the three collapsed classes as hard labels, label smoothing searched. Learning-rate grid [0.000112, 0.000335, 0.00101] from the range test. Temperature 1.069 fitted on out-of-fold logits.
